# Working with Collections

Collections let you manage repeating content as a set of files.

## Declaring a collection

Each collection is declared in `site.yml`, and every item compiles into
`/data/<name>.json`. See the [collections guide](/docs/authoring/collections)
for the full story.

Text can be **bold**, *italic*, or ***both***. A literal &lt;name&gt; stays
escaped in prose, and `a &amp; b` keeps its entity inside code.
